title: Modular C++ Inventory and Order Platform
objective: Develop a maintainable, tested C++ application that manages products, stock, customers and orders.
skills: Functions, classes, RAII, standard containers, algorithms, templates where justified, persistence, exception safety, testing, Git, CMake, static analysis and release practices
required_features: Itemized totals, discounts and basic tax calculations
Persistence with a defined format or database library
Error handling for missing records and failed storage
Logging, validation and repeatable release build
stretch_features: Add a structured logging option and a reproducible benchmark or diagnostic report.
Add extra automated boundary/failure tests and document the trade-off behind one design choice.
